prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama wins the 2008 US presidential election. Specific claims: (1) The winner is the challenger/change candidate, Obama, defeating John McCain — the Saturn–Uranus opposition exact from Election Day (4 November 2008) breaks for Uranus: the old-guard, older establishment candidate (Saturn) loses to the insurgent 'change' candidate. (2) Obama first secures the Democratic nomination over Hillary Clinton (he already leads and does not collapse), then wins the general election. Timing: decided on Election Day, 4 November 2008 (single-day event scale).
basis:
Card face carries no tradition/system field; system actually used: Western mundane/electional astrology (per method western-astro chapter, modern planets admitted as supplementary signatures and labelled as such).
Card-given data only: asked 20 May 2008; Obama leads Clinton for the nomination, McCain is presumptive Republican nominee; Saturn–Uranus opposition begins on Election Day, last seen ~45 years earlier (the mid-1960s upheaval cycle). Reading: Saturn signifies age, incumbency, the establishment — embodied by the septuagenarian McCain; Uranus signifies rupture and generational change — embodied by Obama's explicit change candidacy. An opposition culminating exactly on the decision day is read as the change pole prevailing in a close structural contest, not as a status-quo hold. No birth charts or election-day chart are given on the card, so no state-level or margin claims are made; confidence reduced accordingly. This is a single-point question; no near/far two-stage split applies beyond nomination-then-general sequence noted in the prediction.
